messages:
andrew: Quick heads-up—starting onboarding for `llama-3-small-v2` into model-catalog. weights are in s3://rw-models/llama-3-small-v2/weights.tar.gz. Planning a staged canary by region (eu-west-1 -> us-west-2) and pin the catalog tag as `llama-3-small:v2-202603`. Need eyes on tokenizer and config validation.

sara: saw the weights landed, thx. Quick Q: tokenizer vocab size here is 50284 but our tokenizers service expects 50257 for the BPE mapping. Is this a mismatch or intentional?

rachel: it's intentional—vendor added 27 extra special tokens for safety markers. We should add a `special_tokens` entry in the tokenizer config to avoid remapping.

sam: ran `config.validate` and it failed on `max_sequence` vs runtime dims. Error snippet:
```
ValidationError: max_sequence (2048) > model.max_positions (1024)
at config.validate(config.yaml)
```
We need to either increase compiled max_positions or set `max_sequence: 1024` in the runtime config for the canary.

andrew: good catch. For canary I'll set runtime override to 1024 and note for full rollout we need a rebuild with 2048. Anyone from infra to confirm we have capacity in eu-west-1 for dedicated canary GPUs?

mike: eu-west-1 has only 2 available A10Gs in the pool. Can do one small canary, but we'll need quota add for larger canaries. Filed INF-4823 to request +4 GPUs, pinged cloud-ops.

natalie: I'll enable region flag in the catalog once config and tokenizer are green. Which fallback variant do you want if v2 spikes latency?

andrew: fallback to `llama-3-small:v1-stable` — keep the same prompt formatting. Also enable automatic fallback when p95 latency > 600ms for 2 consecutive mins.

zoe: need alert hooks — can we emit prefixed metric `catalog.canary.llama3s.v2.latency.p95` and have grafana dashboard? I'll wire alerts to #eng-oncall.

infra-bot: CI check report for branch `catalog/llama3s-v2`:
- config.yaml lint: PASS
- tokenizer schema: WARN (special_tokens missing)
- unit tests: PASS
- canary plan doc missing: FAIL
Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/78923

rachel: pushing tokenizer patch now, adding `special_tokens` and explicit `vocab_size: 50284`. Also added compat shim so token ids >50257 map to reserved range.

sam: re-ran `config.validate` locally with `max_sequence: 1024` override, passes. Patch attached:
```
runtime_overrides:
  max_sequence: 1024
  batch_size: 8
```

andrew: perfect. Action items:
- rachel -> PR to tokenizer + compat shim (in review)
- sam -> add runtime_overrides to canary config (merged)
- mike -> quota +1 A10G in eu-west-1 (INF-4823)
- natalie -> enable region flag and set fallback to v1 once PRs green
- zoe -> dashboard + alert rule (threshold: p95 > 600ms x2min)

andrew: tagging reviewers @sara @sam @rachel. If nobody objects I'll trigger canary tomorrow 10:00 UTC. :thumbsup: 

sara: :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: https://deploys.internal/canary/llama3s-v2?time=2026-03-18T10:00:00Z

andrew: thanks all. I'll drop final roll checklist in the doc and link here when done.
